about_the_game:
ABOUT THE GAME:
Phobias: Memories of the Past a horror game focused on exploring real human phobias to create fear and tension. You are a man living the nightmares from your past life sins. In a place where you have to save yourself from death, you'll never be alone again.



MECHANICS:
Controlling the Character with the WASD keys on your keyboard and using the Mouse to move the camera you must escape the place while there are enemies behind you, with each level that passes a new mechanic such as: A weapon to shoot enemies, flashlights with batteries, places to hide and more!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 7020U 2.30GHz or AMD equivalent or better
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 950 or AMD Radeon™ R7 370
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 9400F 2.9Ghz or AMD equivalent or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon™ RX 480
